officialMap.title: Surveillance map
officialMap.subtitle: District-level crop health in your region

officialMap.selectDistrictHelp: Select a map bubble or a table row to see crops, conditions, and counts.
officialMap.legendNote: Bubble size represents the number of observations. Each condition is a district average, not a farm-level value.
officialMap.heatNote: Intensity is based on the district risk score and the number of reporting holdings.
officialMap.noDistrictsHelp: Districts appear when locations are recorded in areas with at least two farms and observations are available in the selected period.
officialMap.loadFailedHelp: The district aggregation could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
officialMap.selectObservationHelp: Select a point on the map or a row in the register to view detailed farmer and crop telemetry.
officialMap.noClustersWindow: No statistical cluster was found in this period. Farm records are spread across different holdings.
officialMap.clusterInsufficient: Fewer than five georeferenced field records were found in this period, so clustering was not attempted. This is a coverage limitation, not a declaration of safety.
officialMap.clusterNone: Sufficient evidence was reviewed and nothing was grouped. Records are spread out rather than concentrated.
officialMap.clusterHonest: These are geographic groups of similar records. Their statistical significance has not been assessed, and they have not been reviewed by an expert.
officialMap.privacyDetails: This view does not show farmer identities or exact farm coordinates. Districts with fewer than two farms are fully hidden, and each marker is based on the district average rounded to approximately one kilometer. All figures are aggregated only for surveillance planning.
officialMap.withheldNote: Districts with too little data to display
